title: Early-1960s UAP event filmed at a military base

tellings.quote: evidence that that recorded that event happening and it happened at a military base

plain: An event involving an unexplained object in the sky was recorded on film at a US military base in the early 1960s, says Eric W. Davis, a physicist who has worked on Pentagon studies of such objects. Davis passes this on second-hand, in an account he links to George H. W. Bush and to a president being briefed on UFOs. If true, the military has had recorded proof of such an event for some sixty years.
